title: GEODIV: FRAMEWORK FOR MEASURING GEOGRAPHICAL DIVERSITY IN TEXT-TO-IMAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting text-to-image models with different country names and measuring the visual diversity of generated entities and backgrounds (Visual Diversity Index) using VQA models to analyze attribute distributions.

Using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to rate generated images on 1-5 scales for Affluence (impoverished to luxury) and Maintenance (damaged to well-maintained) to calculate a Socio-Economic Visual Index (SEVI).
Evaluating images using VLMs and human annotators on a Cultural Localization scale to assess whether the images depict region-specific traditional features or generic, globalized visual cues.
